d:
A slender, humanoid plant species with a deep forest green body and a red, rose-like flower bouquet on each wrist. The head features a wide-brimmed, deep crimson hat and a single, pale cream rosebud on top. It has narrow, sharp, ruby red eyes and a slender, elegant build. It possesses a long, thin, whip-like deep forest green tail. Three claws per hand.
BODY COLOR: deep forest green
